(a) transition_ticket uses optimistic concurrency. If the ticket changed while the 10-minute gate ran, the from-status check, close_class/reason validation and the atomic close bundle must be re-run, and a refusal must be reported. (b) The run index has no field for the transition outcome. _terminal_from_result maps any completed gate, including a BLOCK/FAIL verdict, to status 'passed', so 'passed' in gate_status cannot tell 'closed', 'gate FAIL', and 'gate PASS but transition refused' apart. (d) The existing starters use READ_ONLY_OPEN_WORLD annotations, but a transition starter mutates. It needs MUTATE, readonly-mode refusal, and the with_push/attach_warning post-processing that the synchronous ToolSpec applies.
